quests.title: A Whole New Craftshop

dialogue.t: Wow, Aino's console has gotten even more advanced!
{NICKNAME}! Paimon! Got more scrap for me? Thanks!
Well, thanks to your help, I can now announce that the Krumkake Craftshop console upgrade plan is complete! Hehe!
Which means, I'm good on materials for now. But, don't be a stranger! You can come hang out with me and Ineffa any time!

quests.description: Thanks to your tireless efforts in collecting materials, the Krumkake Craftshop’s workbench has a spanking new groove…
